C-EDITOR-A11Y-CSS.Name: Editor accessibility and system typography closeout: visible keyboard focus on every remaining Settings-window control and the chrome system font on the two body-teleported imperative dialogs, with the already-delivered wave findings (quick-settings keyboard support, sheet focus trap, custom-CSS clear) pinned as current-state regressions
C-EDITOR-A11Y-CSS.Summary: Close out the editor-window accessibility and typography findings (the wave-5 audit items F-005/F-006/F-008/F-010 plus the frontend-ds wave-35 Guard card F-011) against the CURRENT tree, where three of the five flagged surfaces are already delivered by predecessors and only two real gap classes remain. The quick-settings «Aa» button already carries role="button" tabindex="0", the Enter+Space keydown pair and the canon :focus-visible outline (src/renderer/src/components/titleBar/quickSettings/index.vue:6-7, :12-13, :513-516 — C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT R-3/R-5, pinned green by tests/renderer/components/quick-settings.test.js:204/:221 and tests/e2e/compact-windows-fit.spec.ts:331); the modal sheet already traps focus through ElFocusTrap with loop and focus restore (src/renderer/src/prefComponents/common/sheet/index.vue:16-38 — R-4, pinned at tests/e2e/compact-windows-fit.spec.ts:399/:427) and its fixed inset:0 overlay already blocks pointer access to the dimmed page; the custom-CSS clear already empties style#custom-styles for real so the active theme owns the cascade again (src/renderer/src/util/theme.js:407-417 — C-PREFS-TRUTH F-001/F-011, pinned at tests/renderer/util/theme.test.js:349). Remaining gap one — visible keyboard focus: the global rule :focus { outline: none; } (src/renderer/src/assets/styles/index.css:230-232) strips every focus outline, and the C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS canon outline was re-added only per control; the Settings window still carries eight interactive controls styled with all: unset (or bare chrome) and no :focus-visible rule — the shared row push button .pref-button (prefComponents/common/buttonRow/index.vue:75-86), the numeric stepper buttons .pref-stepper-btn (prefComponents/common/range/index.vue:219-226), the Appearance tab family tiles .theme-family-tile (prefComponents/tabs/appearance/index.vue:319-327 — the Settings-window twin of the quick-settings tile that C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT did cover), the dictionary remove button .pref-dictionary-remove (prefComponents/tabs/editor/dictionaryList.vue:144-154), the image-folder Choose/Open button .pref-image-folder-btn and the Reset confirm buttons .pref-reset-btn (prefComponents/tabs/advanced/index.vue:269-281, :331-342), the Custom CSS sheet's Close/Save buttons .pref-custom-css-btn (prefComponents/tabs/advanced/sheets/customCssSheet.vue:112-123) and the keybindings sheet action buttons .pref-keybindings-btn (prefComponents/keybindings/index.vue:301-313) — so keyboard users Tab onto them and see nothing. Remaining gap two — system typography: the chrome rule font-family: var(--chromeFontFamily) (the -apple-system system stack, index.css:19) covers .el-dialog since C-38 T-006 N4a (index.css:560-584), but body carries no font-family (index.css:234-259) and the two imperative body-teleported dialogs name no font — the three-action unsaved-close dialog .ag-unsaved-close-dialog (components/editorWithTabs/unsavedCloseDialog.css:21-31, appended to document.body at unsavedCloseDialog.js:96) and the workspace Add-or-Replace chooser / replace confirm .workspace-mode-dialog (components/sideBar/workspaceModeDialog.vue:206-217, teleported at :2) — so both render in the WKWebView default font, not the app chrome stack. This change is CSS-only: the canon 2px var(--prefAccent) outline with 1px offset under :focus-visible lands beside each named control's own chrome; the two dialogs gain font-family: var(--chromeFontFamily); a static inventory pin guards that no all:unset interactive control in the prefComponents tree lacks a :focus-visible rule; the three already-delivered surfaces are pinned as current-state regressions (recorded honestly green-today, never relabelled as red-first); no JavaScript, no tabindex or role changes, no i18n, no redesign.

Problem.Description: Wave-5 audit findings F-005/F-006/F-008/F-010 and the frontend-ds wave-35 Guard card F-011, re-verified anchor by anchor against this base (worktree green-w5d, branch spec/editor-a11y-css, base 09226066). Three findings are already closed here and must not be re-fixed. (a) F-005, the quick-settings button: the button is a role="button" div with tabindex="0" (src/renderer/src/components/titleBar/quickSettings/index.vue:6-7), binds @keydown.enter.prevent="toggle" and @keydown.space.prevent="toggle" (:12-13, the C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT R-5 delivery citing the components/recent/index.vue enter+space precedent) and carries the canon outline under .quick-settings-btn:focus-visible (:513-516) beside the panel-internal .quick-tab/.quick-openall rule (:374-378); green pins exist at tests/renderer/components/quick-settings.test.js:204 («activates the panel on Space keydown with the default prevented») and :221 (Enter) and at tests/e2e/compact-windows-fit.spec.ts:331 («shows keyboard focus on the quick-settings Aa button and Space opens the panel») — a red-first keyboard pin on this surface is impossible on this base and the spec must not pretend otherwise. (b) F-010, the settings modal sheet: the sheet wraps its panel in el-focus-trap with :trapped="open" and loop (src/renderer/src/prefComponents/common/sheet/index.vue:16-38 — R-4 of C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT, the element-plus/es/components/focus-trap deep import :81), Escape stays the capture-phase handler (:117-123), and the overlay itself is position: fixed; inset: 0 (:144-154) so the dimmed page's buttons are not pointer-reachable either; trap pins exist at tests/e2e/compact-windows-fit.spec.ts:399 (Tab wrap never reaches the page behind) and :427 (focus restored to the invoking control) plus the unit suites tests/renderer/pages/common/sheet.test.js and tests/renderer/prefComponents/pref-sheet.test.js. (c) F-011, the custom-CSS clear: util/theme.js addCustomStyle empties the existing style#custom-styles element on a falsy customCss instead of early-returning (:407-417, C-PREFS-TRUTH F-001/F-011), the reset path delivers the falsy value through the store — customCss sits in RESETTABLE_PREFERENCE_KEYS (src/renderer/src/store/preferences.js:515) and RESET_PREFERENCES_TO_DEFAULTS writes this[key] = defaults[key] (:1157), firing pages/app.vue watch(customCss) → addCustomStyle (app.vue:266-268) — and the clear path is pinned green at tests/renderer/util/theme.test.js:349 (the «addCustomStyle C-PREFS-TRUTH clear path (F-001/F-011)» describe: after an empty save the layer is emptied and the theme stylesheets own the cascade again); no theme variable override survives a clear in this tree. Two real gap classes remain. GAP ONE — visible keyboard focus in the Settings window: index.css opens with the global :focus { outline: none; } (src/renderer/src/assets/styles/index.css:230-232), so focus is invisible everywhere unless a control re-declares it; the C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS and C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT deliveries re-added the canon outline (2px solid var(--prefAccent), 1px offset, :focus-visible only) to the shared switch/segment/select controls and to five named surfaces (.pref-tab at prefComponents/tabsBar/index.vue:180, .pref-sheet-close at prefComponents/common/sheet/index.vue:208, the quick-settings tile/linkish/Aa trio in the quickSettings and quickSettings tab components) — but the Settings window still renders eight interactive controls whose chrome begins with all: unset and which carry no :focus-visible rule at all, verified per file: the shared row push button .pref-button (prefComponents/common/buttonRow/index.vue:75-86 — the Updates/Shortcuts/Extensions/Reset action rows), the numeric stepper up/down buttons .pref-stepper-btn (prefComponents/common/range/index.vue:219-226, the buttons at :18-40 — the audit's «числовые поля»), the Appearance tab family tiles .theme-family-tile (prefComponents/tabs/appearance/index.vue:319-327 — the same class name as the quick-settings View-tab tile that C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT R-3 DID cover in viewTab.vue, but the Settings-window twin in appearance/index.vue carries no focus rule; the file contains no focus rule at all), the dictionary remove button .pref-dictionary-remove (prefComponents/tabs/editor/dictionaryList.vue:144-154), the image-folder Choose/Open button .pref-image-folder-btn (prefComponents/tabs/advanced/index.vue:269-281), the Reset confirmation dialog's Cancel/Confirm buttons .pref-reset-btn (:331-342, the alertdialog at :107-120), the Custom CSS sheet's Close/Save buttons .pref-custom-css-btn (prefComponents/tabs/advanced/sheets/customCssSheet.vue:112-123) and the keybindings sheet's action buttons .pref-keybindings-btn (prefComponents/keybindings/index.vue:301-313) — Tab reaches every one of them (real button elements, no tabindex manipulation) and shows nothing. The text fields are NOT part of this gap: .pref-field (prefComponents/common/textBox/index.vue:142 outline:none) and its siblings show the field canon — a border-color change to var(--prefAccent) under :focus (:153-155, likewise the keybindings search field at keybindings/index.vue:297-299, the image-folder field at advanced/index.vue:261-263 and the CSS textarea at customCssSheet.vue:104-106) — a visible focus indication already; the audit's «числовые поля» refers to the stepper BUTTONS, which have nothing. GAP TWO — system typography on the imperative dialogs: the chrome system stack --chromeFontFamily (index.css:19: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, system-ui, …) is applied to the el-dialog family by the C-38 T-006 N4a rule (index.css:560-584, the comment names rename / import / tweet / export / about / what's new, extended 2026-11-13 to the notification stack) — but html and body declare no font-family (index.css:234-259), so any dialog teleported outside those chrome selectors inherits the WKWebView default serif-ish font. Two live dialogs do exactly that: the three-action unsaved-close dialog builds .ag-unsaved-close-overlay/.ag-unsaved-close-dialog imperatively and appends to document.body (src/renderer/src/components/editorWithTabs/unsavedCloseDialog.js:96; unsavedCloseDialog.css:21-31 styles the box with float tokens and sets no font-family anywhere in the file), and the workspace Add-or-Replace chooser with its replace dirty-confirm teleports .workspace-mode-overlay to body (src/renderer/src/components/sideBar/workspaceModeDialog.vue:2) and its .workspace-mode-dialog styles (:206-217) set no font-family — both dialogs render the FIX-011/C-MULTI-SOURCE-WORKSPACE action model in the wrong type family, breaking the C-38 T-006 decision that everything around the document uses the system UI font. (Their keyboard focus is already correct: .ag-unsaved-close-btn:focus-visible at unsavedCloseDialog.css:99-102 and .workspace-mode-btn:focus-visible at workspaceModeDialog.vue:261-264, each on the float --themeColor accent per the editor-window precedent where --prefAccent does not exist.)

C-EDITOR-A11Y-CSS.Relationship: Three delivered predecessors own the surfaces this change only pins, and one canon owner supplies the presentation law. C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS (archived, applied) is the design authority for every new outline: the 2px solid var(--prefAccent) outline with 1px offset, rendered under :focus-visible only, added beside the control's own chrome; its SummaryDelta lives in the M-011 card (.grace/graph/runtime.xml:2646) and its scenario in V-M-011 (runtime.xml:3584 scenario-settings-keyboard-focus). C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT (archived, applied 2026-11-21) delivered the wave-35 frontend-design fixes this audit re-flags: R-5 the Aa Space activation, R-3 the five focus-visible rules (toolbar tab, Aa button, View-tab family tile, Page-tab Reset row, sheet Close), R-4 the ElFocusTrap sheet trap — its spec/plan record the F-id mapping of that wave (F-002/F-003 fit, F-005/F-006 focus, F-007 trap, F-010 Space) and deliberately scoped OUT the titlebar theme-toggle siblings and every control this change now names; its e2e (tests/e2e/compact-windows-fit.spec.ts) and the settings-shell harness (tests/e2e/settings-shell.spec.ts:17-19, :100 — focusThroughKeyboard/checkKeyboardFocus with the WebKit Option-Tab fallback recording and the pointer-first fresh context) are the evidence canons this change extends, not reworks. C-PREFS-TRUTH (archived, applied 2026-11-21) owns the CSS-clear truth this change pins (theme.js v2.3.0, the F-001/F-011 fix and its theme.test.js describe). C-PREFS-WRITE-TRUTH (an active sibling draft in this worktree's active set) owns the SET_SINGLE_PREFERENCE write semantics — untouched here; this change edits no store action, and its watcher-replay enumeration (watch(customCss) addCustomStyle among the idempotent re-assertions) stays byte-identical because this change is CSS-only. C-EXPORT-SETTINGS-SECTION (delivered) owns the Settings-window IA this change decorates — General first, Export before Advanced, the app-level modal removed (its M-011 SummaryDelta at runtime.xml:2647; M-072 owns immediate defaults and persistence status) — no row moves, no section changes. Zone ownership: every touched file lives under M-011 mt-renderer (.grace/graph/runtime.xml:2638, the card that already carries the C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS and C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT SummaryDeltas) with evidence in V-M-011; M-061 (.grace/graph/performance.xml:829, the quick-settings shell) is a read-only adjacency — the quick-settings surface is delivered and untouched, so no M-061/V-M-061 delta lands. Source records: the wave-5 audit (findings F-005/F-006/F-008/F-010) and the frontend-ds wave-35 Guard card (F-011, custom-CSS clear); their F-id to surface mapping is recorded in Assumptions with the current-tree delivery state per finding.

Goals.R-1: FOCUS-CLOSEOUT (failing-first): every named Settings-window interactive control shows the C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS canon outline for keyboard focus. Each of the eight selectors gains exactly one rule beside its control's own chrome in its owning file — .pref-button (prefComponents/common/buttonRow/index.vue), .pref-stepper-btn (prefComponents/common/range/index.vue), .pref-tab-page--appearance .theme-family-tile (prefComponents/tabs/appearance/index.vue), .pref-dictionary-remove (prefComponents/tabs/editor/dictionaryList.vue), .pref-image-folder-btn and .pref-reset-btn (prefComponents/tabs/advanced/index.vue), .pref-custom-css-btn (prefComponents/tabs/advanced/sheets/customCssSheet.vue), .pref-keybindings-btn (prefComponents/keybindings/index.vue) — each exactly outline: 2px solid var(--prefAccent); outline-offset: 1px; inside :focus-visible only. Selected/on/active state stays visually distinct from keyboard focus (the tile's 2.5px selected ring is a box-shadow, the Reset Confirm danger fill and the primary Save fill are backgrounds — none collides with an outline); pointer activation stays outline-free. No JavaScript, no tabindex changes, no new tokens or wrappers, no redesign of any control. A static inventory pin (a new tests/renderer/prefComponents/settings-focus-inventory.test.js) walks the prefComponents sources and fails while any interactive element whose style block starts with all: unset lacks a :focus-visible rule in the same file — red today on all eight, green after, and it keeps the class from recurring (text-field controls that carry the :focus border-color canon are exempt and listed in the pin's allowlist with their field-canon justification).
Goals.R-2: DIALOG-SYSTEM-TYPE (failing-first): the two body-teleported imperative dialogs render in the chrome system font. .ag-unsaved-close-dialog (unsavedCloseDialog.css) and .workspace-mode-dialog (workspaceModeDialog.vue) each gain font-family: var(--chromeFontFamily) — the same declaration the C-38 T-006 N4a rule applies to .el-dialog (index.css:583), referencing the existing token (index.css:19) with no new variable, no font-size or metric change (both dialogs' sizes are already declared per element) and no theme coupling: light and dark parity is untouched, the float tokens stay. The e2e evidence extends the existing dialog-theme suite: tests/e2e/unsaved-dialog-theme.spec.ts pins the unsaved dialog's computed font-family resolving to the chrome stack in both the light boot and the existing dark-theme flow, and a workspace-dialog leg pins the same computed assertion for .workspace-mode-dialog (its fix is plain CSS, so one computed-style pin per dialog is the honest proof; the suite's resolveVar computed-style pattern is the model). Before the fix both computed values are the WKWebView default family, not the -apple-system stack — red on the pre-change tree.
Goals.R-3: CURRENT-STATE REGRESSION PINS (honest, green-today): the three already-delivered wave surfaces are pinned as regressions so this bundle proves the audit findings stay closed without re-fixing them. (a) The quick-settings keyboard contract stays pinned exactly as delivered — Space and Enter activate the panel with the default prevented (tests/renderer/components/quick-settings.test.js:204/:221) and the real-keyboard e2e shows the canon outline on the Aa button and opens the panel with Space (tests/e2e/compact-windows-fit.spec.ts:331); this bundle adds no quick-settings pin and touches no quick-settings file. (b) The sheet trap stays pinned as delivered — Tab wrap inside the panel never reaches the page behind and close restores the invoking control's focus (tests/e2e/compact-windows-fit.spec.ts:399/:427); the pointer-block leg of the finding (background buttons unreachable while the overlay shows) is covered by the overlay's inset:0 geometry and needs no new pin beyond a recorded assertion comment in the extended settings-shell spec — the plan may add one cheap computed check that .pref-sheet-overlay covers the viewport while open. (c) The custom-CSS clear stays pinned as delivered — the theme.test.js clear-path describe (tests/renderer/util/theme.test.js:349) proves an empty save empties style#custom-styles and the active theme owns the cascade again; the reset leg rides the same watcher delivery (RESET_PREFERENCES_TO_DEFAULTS writes this[customCss] = '' through the store, preferences.js:1157). These pins are recorded as current-state evidence, never relabelled as red-first defect detectors — the C-PREFS-WRITE-TRUTH R-3 honesty convention.
Goals.R-4: Governance: the touched governed files get VERSION bumps and CHANGE_SUMMARY entries per the modification checklist (buttonRow/index.vue, range/index.vue, appearance/index.vue, dictionaryList.vue, advanced/index.vue, customCssSheet.vue, keybindings/index.vue, unsavedCloseDialog.css, workspaceModeDialog.vue — CSS-only diffs, each annotated); the graph and verification deltas (.grace/graph/runtime.xml, .grace/verification/runtime.xml) land in the same bundle as the code, strictly on the M-011/V-M-011 entries, with scenarios naming the new pins; no version change, release, tag or publication is authorized by this specification; M-061/V-M-061 receive no delta (the quick-settings surface is untouched).

Constraints.Item: Spec-only pass: this bundle adds spec.xml only; plan.xml is a separate pass with its own owner approval; no product code, no tests and no graph/verification edits happen in this pass. The ObservedWriteScope below binds the implementation bundle, not this draft.

Fix direction is binding, focus: the C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS canon exactly — outline: 2px solid var(--prefAccent); outline-offset: 1px; under :focus-visible only, per control, beside the control's own chrome — NOT a global rule re-enabling outlines (index.css:230 stays), NOT a JavaScript focus manager, NOT tabindex or role changes, NOT a redesign of any control; selected/active state keeps its own presentation (box-shadow ring, fills) and stays visually distinct from the outline; pointer activation stays outline-free (pinned by the settings-shell harness's pointer-first fresh context). In the two editor-window dialogs the accent token is the established float-surface var(--themeColor) (the unsavedCloseDialog.css:99-102 and workspaceModeDialog.vue:261-264 precedents); the Settings window controls resolve --prefAccent from the pref palette already present in every touched scope.

Fix direction is binding, typography: the two imperative dialogs declare font-family: var(--chromeFontFamily) on their box selectors — mirroring the delivered .el-dialog rule (index.css:583) — NOT a body/html-wide font (the document itself is protected by design: .editor-wrapper carries the editor font inline, and a body-wide rule would touch every surface for one bug class), NOT new font-size or metric declarations, NOT an Element Plus configuration change; the unsaved dialog keeps its FIX-007 float-token parity and the workspace dialog keeps its C-MULTI-SOURCE-WORKSPACE anatomy byte-identical otherwise.

Honesty bar: the wave-5 findings F-005 (quick-settings keyboard), F-010 (sheet trap) and F-011 (CSS clear) are recorded as ALREADY DELIVERED on this base, each with its green pin named; only F-006 (the eight settings-window controls) and F-008 (the two imperative dialogs) carry red-first legs; no pin is asserted red that is green today, and the inventory pin's red-first status is stated per selector.

Predecessor contracts stay green and unweakened: the C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT e2e suite (compact-windows-fit.spec.ts) and the settings-shell suite pass unchanged except for additive pins; the C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS switch/select/segment outlines and their scenario keep passing; the C-PREFS-TRUTH theme.test.js pins (including the clear-path describe) keep passing; the C-PREFS-WRITE-TRUTH preferences-write-truth suite keeps passing; npm test and the e2e suite stay clean against the recorded pre-existing baseline.

No release or train admission follows from this specification; approval does not approve an unwritten plan; the draft enters through the standard review gates.

No redesign and no new features: no control anatomy, palette, spacing or layout change; no new settings rows, no new dialogs, no focus-trap work beyond what is delivered (the sheet is done; the reset alertdialog keeps its current keyboard model), no scroll or viewport work (C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT owns fit), no tabindex roving, no aria changes beyond what exists.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Focus closeout (failing-first): before the fix, Tab-reaching any of the eight named controls (.pref-button, .pref-stepper-btn, .pref-tab-page--appearance .theme-family-tile, .pref-dictionary-remove, .pref-image-folder-btn, .pref-reset-btn, .pref-custom-css-btn, .pref-keybindings-btn) inside the Settings window shows no focus indication — the global index.css:230 rule removes the outline and no :focus-visible rule exists — so every new settings-shell pin is red on the pre-change tree; after, the checkKeyboardFocus harness (tests/e2e/settings-shell.spec.ts:100 canon: real Tab with the WebKit Option-Tab fallback recorded, focused element matches :focus-visible, computed outline 2px var(--prefAccent) at 1px offset, pointer-first fresh context shows no outline, Tab-away clears it) proves each control, and the selected/active presentation stays distinct from the outline (the appearance tile's selected 2.5px ring remains a box-shadow under the outline). The existing switch/select/segment/tabsBar/sheet-close coverage keeps passing byte-identically.

Inventory guard (failing-first): tests/renderer/prefComponents/settings-focus-inventory.test.js walks the prefComponents component sources, collects interactive elements whose style block carries all: unset, and asserts each has a :focus-visible rule in the same file (text-field controls on the documented field-canon allowlist exempt) — red today on the eight named controls, green after the fix, and green forever after as the regression guard for the class; the allowlist is asserted non-empty with its justification so the exemption cannot silently grow.
